info.title: Open Exchange public read API
info.description: Plain HTTP reads over the exchange's index: JSON unless the route says bytes; list parameters are comma-separated and answered one record per key in query order. Writes stay on the overlay protocol (`POST /submit`, BRC-22; `POST /lookup`, BRC-24) and on `/sendMessage` and `/call`; the host reads `/<app>/.live/<topic>` and `/<app>/.events` stay as they are. Cache classes: `state` = `Cache-Control: public, max-age=5`; `imm` = `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`, only for the bytes of a proven (mined) transaction, else `state`; `stream` = `text/event-stream`, no cache. `{token}` is a token id `<txid>_<vout>`; a token's routes are under its instance, `/@<token>/amm/…`. Each operation carries `x-cache` (its class) and `x-answered-by`.

get.description: Every enabled token instance's P2 pools in one array, each row with its `tokenId`. A token whose read fails is left out. With `Accept: text/event-stream` the answer is an event stream (`Cache-Control: no-cache`): the current answer as the first event `pools`, then the answer again each time it changed (sent only when its JSON differs). Each event: `event: pools`, `data: <the JSON answer>`. The stream also sends when a token is enabled or disabled.

get.summary: A token's live pools and its market
get.description: `pools`: the token instance's listed pools whose validator is beating on `tm_color_<token>-live` now (its peer ID from the beat) and whose `commissionBps` is at least the market's `minCommissionBps`; `market` is the instance's P7 market; `validators` is every validator beating on `tm_color_<token>-live` now (identity and peer ID). With `Accept: text/event-stream` the answer is an event stream (`Cache-Control: no-cache`): the current answer as the first event `pools`, then the answer again each time it changed (sent only when its JSON differs). Each event: `event: pools`, `data: <the JSON answer>`.

502.description: The instance's pool lookup or `/amm/terms` read failed (e.g. no such token instance).

get.description: The LP keys' current pools (live, or a rescinded pool's output, which the LP's Close takes back) in query order (a key with neither: nothing), or with no `lp` every live pool; `beef` is the base64 of one BEEF of their transactions.

parameters.name: lp
parameters.description: LP public keys, comma-separated (33 bytes hex each). Absent: every live pool.

400.description: A key that is not hex of its length.

404.description: No token yet: this instance has had no deploy.

get.description: One record per LP key in query order: the pool's status, its current pool (live or rescinded), and the LP fees its swaps paid. An unknown key answers `closed` with zeros.

400.description: `lp` missing, or a key that is not hex of its length.

get.description: One record per validator identity key in query order: the validator fees over all its pools of this token (closed included); `pools` the distinct pools counted.

400.description: `id` missing, or a key that is not hex of its length.

get.description: One record per commission pkh in query order: the commissions the swaps naming it paid.

parameters.name: pkh
parameters.description: Commission public key hashes, comma-separated (20 bytes hex each).

400.description: `pkh` missing, or a hash that is not hex of its length.

get.description: The instance's validator terms (null: a market only) and its market, unsigned: `amm.pool.terms` and `amm.swap.terms` in one.

What the chain state says of each outpoint: its spender and, for a pool output, the pool's current output. One outpoint answers the single object; several (a comma in the value) answer one record per outpoint in query order.
The transaction's Atomic BEEF from the chain state (its ancestry back to proven transactions), as bytes.

Cache-Control.description: `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` when the transaction is proven (mined, its BUMP in the chain state), else `public, max-age=5`.

get.description: The relay record as `amm.swap.status` answers it, unsigned (the signed `/call amm.swap.status` stays). The swap id is the sha256 of the swap, 64 hex characters.
The head `amm/token`: the token this instance serves.

404.description: No token: this instance has taken no deploy event.

get.description: The swap instance's enable list, every status, newest first.

Every token whose deploy the discovery topic `tm_color` admitted, newest first, paged; or with `ids`, one row per id in query order (`{tokenId, listed: false}` for an id not listed). `ids` beside `limit`/`skip`, a malformed id or an empty `ids`: 400.
The token's deploy fields as discovery lists it.

404.description: Not a token id, or not listed.

get.description: The deploy's embedded icon bytes with its media type. A BRC-161 JSON deploy (icon a string) has no icon here: 404 (its list/detail `iconUrl` is that string when it is an http(s) URL).

Cache-Control.description: `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` when the deploy is proven, else `public, max-age=5`.

404.description: No such token, or no embedded icon.

get.description: The deploy transaction's Atomic BEEF from the chain state.

Cache-Control.description: `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` when the deploy is proven, else `public, max-age=5`.

get.description: At an instance's origin (`/@<handle>/.well-known/skein`, or the root instance at the bare origin): `{handle, identity, origin, claimed}`.

get.summary: Instances a key holds root on
get.description: The instances on this host whose grants name `key` among root's holders.
`{claimant, since}`, or `{}` while unclaimed.
`{terms?, market?}` (`{}` when none is set).
`{on, since}`, or `{on: false}` with no record.
The OpenAPI 3.1 document of the public read API.

get.x-answered-by: files in the swap app's www/

get.description: An HTML page rendered from `openapi.json`.
get.x-cache: as the swap pages are served
get.x-answered-by: files in the swap app's www/

Error.description: A refusal from an amm-p2p read (P3–P10): `{error}`, no Cache-Control.

Problem.description: A refusal from the host or a 1Color/swap read: `{status: "error", code?, description? | message?}`.

PoolState.description: A listed pool as the pool lookup (`ls_amm_<token>`, query `{tokenId}`) renders it. Reserves in the smallest unit (satoshis; the token's base unit).

lpPubKey.description: The LP's public key (33 bytes hex) = the pool id.

validatorIdentityKey.description: The validator's identity key (33 bytes hex).

validatorPeerId.description: The validator's libp2p peer ID, from its beat on `tm_color_<token>-live`.

Market.description: The instance's market: the commission pkh this relay is paid at, and its minimum commission (0 when unset).

peerId.description: libp2p peer ID, from the beat.

validators.description: Every validator beating on the token's topic now, whatever its pools (a pool below the market minimum is not listed, its validator still is).

tokens.description: LP fees earned in the token's base unit.

validator.description: null: no terms set, this instance is a market only.

current.description: For a pool output: the pool's current output `<txid>.<vout>`, followed spender to spender.

closed.description: A pool spent by a transaction that did not continue it (Close).

SwapRecord.description: The relay record as `amm.swap.status` answers it, as dag-json (bytes are `{"/": {"bytes": <base64>}}`).

iconUrl.description: Origin-relative: `/@discovery/1color/<tokenId>/icon` (404 there when discovery is off or the deploy has no embedded icon).
Relative to the list (`<tokenId>/icon`) for an embedded icon; a BRC-161 deploy's http(s) icon URL as is; absent when none.
